title: 第17章 县城开铺第18章 东市西市
content_zh:
;;
面对围攻，许明巍主要以抵挡和闪避为主。
他身形呈s形路线，提膝摆臂，进行抵挡。
落地时足尖点地，爆发集中一点，让速度激增，穿梭几人之间。
仿佛一条火龙超越沼泽时，同时兼具柔韧与爆发。
此招乃《小龙象功》上的身法式，龙游曲沼。
如此来回游走，十几个呼吸后三人的围攻就出现了破绽。
许明巍双眼闪过犀利的眸光。
一记扫堂腿，直接将其中两人扫飞，然后趁势扭转身躯，浮跃至半空。
右腿如战斧一般劈在最后一人的肩膀。
蓬~
那无以伦比的力量仿佛千斤巨石，直接压得他单膝跪倒在地，额头更是冒出无数细汗。
“到此为止吧。”许川突然开口。
闻言，许明巍收回了脚。
长吐一口气，神色如常，脸上甚至都不见一滴汗水。
赵大龙三人起身，对着他抱拳躬身，脸上充满了敬佩之色，口中齐声道：“多谢大公子手下留情。”
“几位客气了，我也只是侥幸略胜一筹而已。”
许川见此满意点点头。
此时，一个粉嘟嘟如同瓷娃娃一般的小女孩走了过来，脆生生地喊道：“阿爹，大哥，二哥，可以吃早饭了。”
李二，赵大龙等人也都开口道，“那家主，我等也先回去了。”

“嗯。”许川点点头。
如果是以前独自一人，在一起吃还没什么。
但现如今他们一个个也都成了家，有自己的子嗣。
再在主家吃喝，就不太合适了。
许家对他们优待，月俸五两，这在整个洞溪村绝对是独一份的。
“我的小雪霁。”
许川走过去一把抱起了她，亲昵地用鼻尖碰了碰，惹得她咯咯笑了起来，道：“阿爹，痒。”
小女孩便是许明姝。
作为唯一的女孩，她在许家集万千宠爱于一身。
八仙桌上。
中心摆放的是一大盆肉沫粥，四周有葱油饼，鸡蛋饼，还有咸菜与腌萝卜。
可谓十分之丰盛。
content_en:
;;
Facing the siege, Xu Mingwei mainly resisted and evaded.
His body formed an S-shape, raising his knees and swinging his arms to resist.
When landing, point your toes to the ground, and concentrate the explosion to increase your speed and shuttle between several people.
Like a fire dragon crossing the swamp, it is both flexible and explosive at the same time.
This move is a body technique in the "Little Dragon Elephant Kung Fu", the dragon swims in the winding marsh.
After wandering back and forth like this, a flaw appeared in the three people's siege after a dozen breaths.
Xu Mingwei's eyes flashed with sharp eyes.
A sweeping kick sent two of them flying, and then they took advantage of the situation to twist their bodies and leap into the air.
The right leg struck the last man's shoulder like a battle axe.
Peng~
The unparalleled force was like a huge boulder, which directly pressed him to the ground on one knee, and countless beads of sweat broke out on his forehead.
"That's it." Xu Chuan suddenly said.
Hearing this, Xu Mingwei took back his foot.
He took a long breath and looked as normal, with not even a drop of sweat on his face.
Zhao Dalong and the other three stood up, clasped their fists and bowed to him, their faces full of admiration, and they said in unison: "Thank you, Lord, for showing mercy."
"You guys are so polite, I was just lucky enough to be slightly better."
Seeing this, Xu Chuan nodded with satisfaction.
At this time, a little girl with a pink face like a porcelain doll came over and shouted crisply: "Dad, eldest brother, second brother, you can have breakfast."
Li Er, Zhao Dalong and others also said, "Master, I will go back first."
"Yeah." Xu Chuan nodded.
If we were alone before, eating together would be fine.
But now they are all married and have their own children.
It would not be appropriate to eat and drink at the host's house anymore.
The Xu family gave them preferential treatment, with a monthly salary of fifty taels, which was definitely unique in the entire Dongxi Village.
"My little Xueji."
Xu Chuan walked over and picked her up, touching her with the tips of his noses affectionately, making her giggle and said, "Dad, it's ticklish."
The little girl is Xu Mingshu.
As the only girl, she is loved by everyone in the Xu family.
On the Eight Immortals table.
In the center is a large bowl of minced meat porridge, surrounded by scallion pancakes, egg pancakes, pickles and pickled radish.
It can be said to be very rich.
